COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  MONDAY, DECEMBER 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner

  REVISED

  SPECIAL MEETING

  COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS IN-PERSON MEETING/VIRTUAL HYBRID MEETING
  PURSUANT TO AB 2449 (GOV. CODE SECTION 54953 (f)(2))

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 987 1037 1877
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/98710371877

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-57225  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and Girls
  meeting of Wednesday, October 22, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-57227  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Ranked Choice Voting and
  its effect on women and girls in the City of Long Beach, from the RCV in the LBC
  Steering Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-57229  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Safety Ad Hoc
  Committee on planning for the upcoming Women’s Safety Conference, and
  discuss additional considerations to support the conference.

  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-57230  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

to the meeting.

https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the

cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

4.  25-60643  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner LaViolette, seconded by Commissioner
  Anckle, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] dissolve the Vision
  Mapping Ad Hoc Committee; [2] create a Ranked Choice Voting Ad Hoc
  Committee, members include Commissioner Allen Harper and Commissioner
  LaViolette; [3] create an Asian and Pacific Islander Women and Girls Ad Hoc
  Committee, members include Commissioner Anckle and Commissioner Chim;
  and [4] appoint Commissioner Anckle and Commissioner Chim to the
  Mentorship and Education Ad Hoc Committee. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  7 Allen Harper, Anckle, Chim, Donato-Sapp, LaViolette, Mosqueda,
  Mehlinger

  Recused: 0 None
